title: Integration of in vivo electrophysiology and optogenetics in rodents with PEDOT:PSS neural electrode array
author: Cho, Lee, et al.

steps.title: Prepare slide glass and PDMS mixture
steps.instruction: Cut a slide glass to 75 mm × 25 mm × 1 mm and set it aside. In a square polystyrene weighing dish, weigh 32 g of PDMS base solution, add 2 g of curing agent (16:1 base‑to‑curing‑agent ratio), and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Degas PDMS mixture
steps.instruction: Place the dish containing the mixed PDMS into a vacuum desiccator and apply vacuum until all air bubbles disappear; maintain the vacuum for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Spin‑coat PDMS onto slide glass
steps.instruction: Fix the slide glass onto the spin‑coater chuck while maintaining vacuum, pour the degassed PDMS solution to completely cover the glass, then spin‑coat at 2000 rpm for 50 seconds.

steps.title: Cure PDMS layer
steps.instruction: Heat the PDMS‑coated glass on a hot plate at 70 °C for 30 minutes, followed by 110 °C for an additional 30 minutes to achieve gradual curing.

steps.title: Laminate PET film onto cured PDMS
steps.instruction: Cut a 25 µm‑thick PET film to 3 cm × 2 cm, then laminate the PET piece onto the fully cured PDMS layer on the glass substrate.
